summary: Created and verified the SFTP-only dropbox account on node1. It is confined to /srv/sftp/dropbox, can write only under incoming, cannot obtain a shell, and remained fully functional after reboot.
actions_performed: Created dropbox with home /incoming and shell /sbin/nologin.
Created root-owned chroot /srv/sftp/dropbox and dropbox-owned incoming directory with mode 0750.
Configured ForceCommand internal-sftp, public-key-only authentication, and disabled TTY and forwarding.
Generated a node-local Ed25519 credential; its private key remains root-only at /root/.ssh/dropbox_sftp_ed25519.
Verified uploads, downloads, confinement, root-write denial, and shell denial.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified its boot ID changed from 717db5a2-895d-4bfb-b8a8-d4891c7b7b01 to 420c0234-3a19-439e-86f6-f5eead4bd0ea.
Verified sshd, configuration, account, files, persisted data, and live SFTP behavior recovered after reboot.

evidence.requirement: dropbox account and secure filesystem layout
evidence.summary: Shows the account identity, /incoming home, nologin shell, root-owned chroot, dropbox-owned writable incoming directory, and protected credential files.
Shows valid effective chroot/internal-sftp policy and direct rejection of normal SSH command execution, including after restart.

evidence.requirement: Functional confinement and writable incoming directory
evidence.summary: Pre- and post-restart SFTP sessions prove /incoming access, successful uploads/downloads, denied chroot-root writes, and invisibility of host /etc.

Captures the healthy baseline and original boot ID, acknowledged safe reboot request, changed boot ID, recovered sshd/configuration/account/data, matching persisted-data hash, and successful post-restart SFTP operations.
